full_judgment: 9. Mr. Muhammad Nawab Ali, the learned 7. By the impugned judgment and order, Advocate-on-Record appearing on behalf which leave was granted. He reiterated the ground that the pre-emptee did not disclose the name of any other co-sharer party before settlement of issues. He pointed out that the pre-emptee disclosed four persons as co-sharers who were subsequently impleaded as opposite party. No further allegation of defect of party having been raised, the High Court Division was in serious error in remanding the case for adding necessary parties.
